// Package streamledger implements StreamLedger — a trustless, zero-dust
// native ugnot vesting and payment-stream escrow realm for Gno.land.
package streamledger

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"chain/runtime"
	"chain/runtime/unsafe"
	"math/overflow"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"gno.land/p/g10epvakwr3x5cd3yu9zstusltjwklke9zxz28d0/streammath"
	"gno.land/p/moul/txlink/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/mux/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"
)

const (
	DenomUGNOT      = "ugnot"
	MaxLabelLength  = 120
	StatusActive    = "ACTIVE"
	StatusCompleted = "COMPLETED"
	StatusCancelled = "CANCELLED"

	realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g10epvakwr3x5cd3yu9zstusltjwklke9zxz28d0/streamledger"
	realmURLPath = "/r/g10epvakwr3x5cd3yu9zstusltjwklke9zxz28d0/streamledger"
)

// Stream represents a single escrowed ugnot payment/vesting stream.
type Stream struct {
	ID              uint64
	Sender          address
	Recipient       address
	TotalAmount     int64
	Withdrawn       int64
	Refunded        int64
	StartHeight     int64
	CliffHeight     int64
	EndHeight       int64
	CreatedHeight   int64
	CancelledHeight int64
	Cancellable     bool
	Status          string
	Label           string
}

var (
	streams     *avl.Tree // formatIDKey(id) -> *Stream
	bySender    *avl.Tree // "<sender>:<idKey>" -> uint64
	byRecipient *avl.Tree // "<recipient>:<idKey>" -> uint64

	nextStreamID   uint64
	totalDeposited int64
	totalWithdrawn int64
	totalRefunded  int64
	activeCount    int64
	completedCount int64
	cancelledCount int64

	router *mux.Router
)

func init() {
	initState()
	initRouter()
}

func initState() {
	streams = avl.NewTree()
	bySender = avl.NewTree()
	byRecipient = avl.NewTree()
	nextStreamID = 0
	totalDeposited = 0
	totalWithdrawn = 0
	totalRefunded = 0
	activeCount = 0
	completedCount = 0
	cancelledCount = 0
}

func initRouter() {
	router = mux.NewRouter()
	router.HandleFunc("", renderHome)
	router.HandleFunc("stream/{id}", renderStreamDetail)
	router.HandleFunc("addr/{address}", renderAddressPortfolio)
	router.SetNotFoundHandler(func(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# StreamLedger — Not Found\n\nUnknown path: `%s`\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", req.Path, realmURLPath))
	})
}

// CreateStream locks attached ugnot in escrow and creates a new linear vesting
// stream from the direct EOA caller to recipient.
func CreateStream(
	cur realm,
	recipient address,
	startHeight int64,
	cliffHeight int64,
	endHeight int64,
	cancellable bool,
	label string,
) uint64 {
	if !cur.Previous().IsUserCall() {
		panic("StreamLedger: only direct user call (maketx call) accepted")
	}

	sender := cur.Previous().Address()
	if recipient == "" || !recipient.IsValid() {
		panic("StreamLedger: invalid recipient address")
	}
	if recipient == sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: sender and recipient must differ")
	}

	deposit := requireUGNOTSent()
	if err := streammath.ValidateSchedule(startHeight, cliffHeight, endHeight, deposit); err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}

	cleanLabel := sanitizeLabel(label)
	newTotalDeposited, ok := overflow.Add64(totalDeposited, deposit)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: protocol deposit overflow")
	}

	nextStreamID++
	id := nextStreamID
	idKey := formatIDKey(id)

	s := &Stream{
		ID:            id,
		Sender:        sender,
		Recipient:     recipient,
		TotalAmount:   deposit,
		Withdrawn:     0,
		Refunded:      0,
		StartHeight:   startHeight,
		CliffHeight:   cliffHeight,
		EndHeight:     endHeight,
		CreatedHeight: runtime.ChainHeight(),
		Cancellable:   cancellable,
		Status:        StatusActive,
		Label:         cleanLabel,
	}

	streams.Set(idKey, s)
	bySender.Set(indexKey(sender, idKey), id)
	byRecipient.Set(indexKey(recipient, idKey), id)
	totalDeposited = newTotalDeposited
	activeCount++

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamCreated",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(id, 10),
		"sender", sender.String(),
		"recipient", recipient.String(),
		"amount_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(deposit, 10),
		"start_height", strconv.FormatInt(startHeight, 10),
		"cliff_height", strconv.FormatInt(cliffHeight, 10),
		"end_height", strconv.FormatInt(endHeight, 10),
		"cancellable", strconv.FormatBool(cancellable),
	)

	return id
}

// Withdraw claims all currently vested, unwithdrawn ugnot for streamID.
// Only the stream's recipient may call Withdraw. Strictly follows CEI.
func Withdraw(cur realm, streamID uint64) int64 {
	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if caller != s.Recipient {
		panic("StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw")
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	amount := streammath.WithdrawableAmount(
		s.TotalAmount,
		s.Withdrawn,
		s.StartHeight,
		s.CliffHeight,
		s.EndHeight,
		now,
	)
	if amount <= 0 {
		panic("StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height")
	}

	// Effects BEFORE external banker interaction (strict CEI).
	s.Withdrawn += amount
	totalWithdrawn += amount
	if s.Withdrawn >= s.TotalAmount {
		s.Status = StatusCompleted
		activeCount--
		completedCount++
	}

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamWithdrawn",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"recipient", s.Recipient.String(),
		"amount_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(amount, 10),
		"total_withdrawn_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(s.Withdrawn, 10),
		"status", s.Status,
	)

	// Interaction LAST.
	bk := banker.NewBanker(banker.BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)
	bk.SendCoins(cur.Address(), s.Recipient, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, amount)))

	return amount
}

// CancelStream cancels an active, cancellable stream. Only the sender may
// cancel. Any vested unwithdrawn balance is sent to the recipient and the
// exact unvested remainder is refunded to the sender (zero dust).
func CancelStream(cur realm, streamID uint64) (int64, int64) {
	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if !s.Cancellable {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is non-cancellable")
	}
	if caller != s.Sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: only sender can cancel")
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	toRecipient, toSender := streammath.CancelSplit(
		s.TotalAmount,
		s.Withdrawn,
		s.StartHeight,
		s.CliffHeight,
		s.EndHeight,
		now,
	)

	// Effects BEFORE external banker interactions (strict CEI).
	s.Withdrawn += toRecipient
	s.Refunded = toSender
	s.CancelledHeight = now
	s.Status = StatusCancelled

	totalWithdrawn += toRecipient
	totalRefunded += toSender
	activeCount--
	cancelledCount++

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamCancelled",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"sender", s.Sender.String(),
		"recipient", s.Recipient.String(),
		"to_recipient_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(toRecipient, 10),
		"to_sender_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(toSender, 10),
		"height", strconv.FormatInt(now, 10),
	)

	// Interactions LAST.
	bk := banker.NewBanker(banker.BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)
	realmAddr := cur.Address()
	if toRecipient > 0 {
		bk.SendCoins(realmAddr, s.Recipient, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, toRecipient)))
	}
	if toSender > 0 {
		bk.SendCoins(realmAddr, s.Sender, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, toSender)))
	}

	return toRecipient, toSender
}

// TopUpStream adds attached ugnot to an active stream before its endHeight.
// Only the original sender may top up.
func TopUpStream(cur realm, streamID uint64) {
	if !cur.Previous().IsUserCall() {
		panic("StreamLedger: only direct user call (maketx call) accepted")
	}

	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if caller != s.Sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: only sender can top up")
	}
	if runtime.ChainHeight() >= s.EndHeight {
		panic("StreamLedger: cannot top up stream at or after end height")
	}

	added := requireUGNOTSent()
	newStreamTotal, ok := overflow.Add64(s.TotalAmount, added)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream total overflow")
	}
	newProtocolTotal, ok := overflow.Add64(totalDeposited, added)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: protocol deposit overflow")
	}

	s.TotalAmount = newStreamTotal
	totalDeposited = newProtocolTotal

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamToppedUp",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"sender", s.Sender.String(),
		"added_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(added, 10),
		"new_total_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(s.TotalAmount, 10),
	)
}

// GetStreamJSON returns a deterministic JSON representation of a stream
// evaluated at the live chain height.
func GetStreamJSON(streamID uint64) string {
	s := getStream(streamID)
	if s == nil {
		return `{"error":"stream not found"}`
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("{")
	b.WriteString(`"id":` + strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"sender":"` + escapeJSON(s.Sender.String()) + `"`)
	b.WriteString(`,"recipient":"` + escapeJSON(s.Recipient.String()) + `"`)
	b.WriteString(`,"label":"` + escapeJSON(s.Label) + `"`)
	b.WriteString(`,"status":"` + s.Status + `"`)
	b.WriteString(`,"cancellable":` + strconv.FormatBool(s.Cancellable))
	b.WriteString(`,"totalAmountUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.TotalAmount, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"withdrawnUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.Withdrawn, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"refundedUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.Refunded, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"vestedUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(vested, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"withdrawableUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(withdrawable, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"remainingUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(remaining, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"startHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.StartHeight, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"cliffHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.CliffHeight, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"endHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.EndHeight, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"createdHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.CreatedHeight, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"cancelledHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(s.CancelledHeight, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"currentHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(now, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"progressBps":` + strconv.FormatInt(bps, 10))
	b.WriteString("}")
	return b.String()
}

// StatsJSON returns protocol-wide accounting metrics as deterministic JSON.
func StatsJSON() string {
	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	tvl := totalDeposited - totalWithdrawn - totalRefunded
	escrowBal := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath), DenomUGNOT)

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("{")
	b.WriteString(`"chainHeight":` + strconv.FormatInt(now, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"totalStreams":` + strconv.FormatUint(nextStreamID, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"activeStreams":` + strconv.FormatInt(activeCount, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"completedStreams":` + strconv.FormatInt(completedCount, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"cancelledStreams":` + strconv.FormatInt(cancelledCount, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"totalDepositedUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(totalDeposited, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"totalWithdrawnUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(totalWithdrawn, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"totalRefundedUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(totalRefunded, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"tvlUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(tvl, 10))
	b.WriteString(`,"escrowBalanceUgnot":` + strconv.FormatInt(escrowBal, 10))
	b.WriteString("}")
	return b.String()
}

// Render serves the interactive gnoweb UI for StreamLedger.
// Supported paths:
//   - ""              : Protocol dashboard & live streams table
//   - "stream/<id>"   : Detailed stream card with one-click txlinks
//   - "addr/<g1...>"  : Outgoing & incoming streams for an address
func Render(path string) string {
	return router.Render(path)
}

func renderHome(res *mux.ResponseWriter, _ *mux.Request) {
	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	tvl := totalDeposited - totalWithdrawn - totalRefunded
	createURL := txlink.NewLink("CreateStream").
		AddArgs(
			"recipient", "g1...",
			"startHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now, 10),
			"cliffHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now+10, 10),
			"endHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now+100, 10),
			"cancellable", "true",
			"label", "Contributor Vesting",
		).
		SetSend("1000000ugnot").
		URL()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# StreamLedger\n\n")
	b.WriteString("**Trustless, zero-dust native GNOT vesting & payment streams on Gno.land.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("Live Chain Height: **`#%d`** · [➕ Create New Stream](%s)\n\n", now, createURL))

	b.WriteString("## Protocol Overview\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Metric | Value |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Locked TVL** | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(tvl), tvl))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Deposited | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalDeposited)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Withdrawn | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalWithdrawn)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Refunded | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalRefunded)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Streams | %d total (%d active · %d completed · %d cancelled) |\n\n",
		nextStreamID, activeCount, completedCount, cancelledCount))

	b.WriteString("## Streams\n\n")
	if streams.Size() == 0 {
		b.WriteString("_No streams created yet. Click **Create New Stream** above to lock your first GNOT vesting stream._\n")
		res.Write(b.String())
		return
	}

	b.WriteString("| ID | Label | Sender | Recipient | Total | Progress | Status |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n")

	streams.ReverseIterate("", "", func(_ string, value any) bool {
		s := value.(*Stream)
		_, _, _, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		bar := streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 10)
		lbl := s.Label
		if lbl == "" {
			lbl = "—"
		}
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf(
			"| [#%d](%s:stream/%d) | %s | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | %s | `%s` | %s |\n",
			s.ID, realmURLPath, s.ID,
			escapeMarkdownCell(lbl),
			shortAddr(s.Sender), realmURLPath, s.Sender.String(),
			shortAddr(s.Recipient), realmURLPath, s.Recipient.String(),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount),
			bar,
			statusBadge(s.Status),
		))
		return false
	})

	b.WriteString("\n---\n")
	b.WriteString("_Powered by pure 128-bit zero-dust math package `p/.../streammath`._\n")
	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderStreamDetail(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	rawID := req.GetVar("id")
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(rawID, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# Invalid Stream ID\n\n`%s` is not a valid stream ID.\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", rawID, realmURLPath))
		return
	}

	s := getStream(id)
	if s == nil {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# Stream #%d Not Found\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", id, realmURLPath))
		return
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
	bar := streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 20)

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n\n", realmURLPath))
	title := ufmt.Sprintf("# Stream #%d", s.ID)
	if s.Label != "" {
		title += " — " + escapeMarkdownCell(s.Label)
	}
	b.WriteString(title + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("**Status:** %s · **Cancellable:** `%t` · **Live Height:** `#%d`\n\n", statusBadge(s.Status), s.Cancellable, now))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("`%s`\n\n", bar))

	b.WriteString("## Escrow & Schedule Details\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Field | Value |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Sender | [%s](%s:addr/%s) |\n", s.Sender.String(), realmURLPath, s.Sender.String()))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Recipient | [%s](%s:addr/%s) |\n", s.Recipient.String(), realmURLPath, s.Recipient.String()))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Escrowed | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount), s.TotalAmount))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Vested | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(vested), vested))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Already Withdrawn | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.Withdrawn), s.Withdrawn))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Withdrawable Now** | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(withdrawable), withdrawable))
	if s.Status == StatusCancelled {
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Refunded to Sender | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.Refunded), s.Refunded))
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Cancelled At Height | `#%d` |\n", s.CancelledHeight))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Remaining Unwithdrawn | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(remaining), remaining))
	}
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Schedule (Start / Cliff / End) | `#%d` / `#%d` / `#%d` |\n", s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Created At Height | `#%d` |\n\n", s.CreatedHeight))

	// Zero-dust conservation proof display
	accounted := s.Withdrawn + s.Refunded + remaining
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("> **Zero-Dust Conservation Check:** `withdrawn (%d) + refunded (%d) + remaining (%d) == total (%d)`\n\n",
		s.Withdrawn, s.Refunded, remaining, accounted))

	if s.Status == StatusActive {
		idStr := strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10)
		withdrawURL := txlink.NewLink("Withdraw").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).URL()
		topUpURL := txlink.NewLink("TopUpStream").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).SetSend("1000000ugnot").URL()

		b.WriteString("## Actions\n\n")
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [💸 Withdraw Vested GNOT](%s) _(recipient only)_\n", withdrawURL))
		if now < s.EndHeight {
			b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [➕ Top Up Stream](%s) _(sender only, before `#%d`)_\n", topUpURL, s.EndHeight))
		}
		if s.Cancellable {
			cancelURL := txlink.NewLink("CancelStream").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).URL()
			b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [🛑 Cancel Stream (Zero-Dust Split)](%s) _(sender only)_\n", cancelURL))
		}
		b.WriteString("\n### CLI Example\n\n")
		b.WriteString("```bash\n")
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("gnokey maketx call -pkgpath %s -func Withdraw -args %d <your-key>\n", realmPkgPath, s.ID))
		b.WriteString("```\n")
	}

	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderAddressPortfolio(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	rawAddr := req.GetVar("address")
	addr := address(rawAddr)
	now := runtime.ChainHeight()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n\n", realmURLPath))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("# Portfolio: `%s`\n\n", rawAddr))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("Live Chain Height: **`#%d`**\n\n", now))

	incoming := collectStreamsByIndex(byRecipient, addr)
	outgoing := collectStreamsByIndex(bySender, addr)

	var totalIncoming, totalClaimable, totalOutgoing int64
	for _, s := range incoming {
		totalIncoming += s.TotalAmount
		_, w, _, _ := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		totalClaimable += w
	}
	for _, s := range outgoing {
		totalOutgoing += s.TotalAmount
	}

	b.WriteString("| Portfolio Summary | Amount |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Incoming Streams (%d) | %s |\n", len(incoming), streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalIncoming)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Claimable Now** | **%s** |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalClaimable)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Outgoing Streams (%d) | %s |\n\n", len(outgoing), streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalOutgoing)))

	b.WriteString("## Incoming Streams (Recipient)\n\n")
	renderStreamList(&b, incoming, now, false)

	b.WriteString("\n## Outgoing Streams (Sender)\n\n")
	renderStreamList(&b, outgoing, now, true)

	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderStreamList(b *strings.Builder, list []*Stream, now int64, isOutgoing bool) {
	if len(list) == 0 {
		b.WriteString("_None._\n")
		return
	}
	counterpartyCol := "Sender"
	if isOutgoing {
		counterpartyCol = "Recipient"
	}
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| ID | Label | %s | Total | Withdrawable | Progress | Status |\n", counterpartyCol))
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n")
	for _, s := range list {
		_, withdrawable, _, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		cp := s.Sender
		if isOutgoing {
			cp = s.Recipient
		}
		lbl := s.Label
		if lbl == "" {
			lbl = "—"
		}
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf(
			"| [#%d](%s:stream/%d) | %s | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | %s | %s | `%s` | %s |\n",
			s.ID, realmURLPath, s.ID,
			escapeMarkdownCell(lbl),
			shortAddr(cp), realmURLPath, cp.String(),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(withdrawable),
			streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 10),
			statusBadge(s.Status),
		))
	}
}

// --- Internal helpers ---

func requireUGNOTSent() int64 {
	sent := unsafe.OriginSend()
	if len(sent) != 1 || sent[0].Denom != DenomUGNOT || sent[0].Amount <= 0 {
		panic("StreamLedger: must send positive ugnot only")
	}
	return sent[0].Amount
}

func sanitizeLabel(label string) string {
	clean := strings.TrimSpace(label)
	if len(clean) > MaxLabelLength {
		panic("StreamLedger: label exceeds maximum length of 120 bytes")
	}
	return clean
}

func formatIDKey(id uint64) string {
	s := strconv.FormatUint(id, 10)
	if len(s) < 20 {
		return strings.Repeat("0", 20-len(s)) + s
	}
	return s
}

func indexKey(addr address, idKey string) string {
	return addr.String() + ":" + idKey
}

func getStream(id uint64) *Stream {
	if id == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	v := streams.Get(formatIDKey(id))
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return v.(*Stream)
}

func mustGetStream(id uint64) *Stream {
	s := getStream(id)
	if s == nil {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream not found")
	}
	return s
}

func collectStreamsByIndex(idx *avl.Tree, addr address) []*Stream {
	prefix := addr.String() + ":"
	end := addr.String() + ";"
	var result []*Stream
	idx.ReverseIterate(prefix, end, func(key string, value any) bool {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(key, prefix) {
			return false
		}
		if id, ok := value.(uint64); ok {
			if s := getStream(id); s != nil {
				result = append(result, s)
			}
		}
		return false
	})
	return result
}

func computeLiveMetrics(s *Stream, now int64) (vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps int64) {
	switch s.Status {
	case StatusCompleted:
		return s.TotalAmount, 0, 0, streammath.MaxBps
	case StatusCancelled:
		return s.Withdrawn, 0, 0, streammath.ProgressBps(s.StartHeight, s.EndHeight, s.CancelledHeight)
	default:
		vested = streammath.VestedAmount(s.TotalAmount, s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		withdrawable = streammath.WithdrawableAmount(s.TotalAmount, s.Withdrawn, s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		remaining = s.TotalAmount - s.Withdrawn
		bps = streammath.ProgressBps(s.StartHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		return vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps
	}
}

func shortAddr(a address) string {
	s := a.String()
	if len(s) <= 14 {
		return s
	}
	return s[:8] + "…" + s[len(s)-4:]
}

func statusBadge(status string) string {
	switch status {
	case StatusActive:
		return "🟢 ACTIVE"
	case StatusCompleted:
		return "✅ COMPLETED"
	case StatusCancelled:
		return "🛑 CANCELLED"
	default:
		return status
	}
}

func escapeMarkdownCell(s string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "|", "\\|")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", " ")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r", "")
	return s
}

func escapeJSON(s string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, `\`, `\\`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, `"`, `\"`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", `\n`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r", `\r`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\t", `\t`)
	return s
}

package streamledger

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"chain/runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func resetRealmForTest() {
	initState()
}

// fundAndCreate simulates a direct EOA MsgCall with attached ugnot.
func fundAndCreate(
	cur realm,
	sender address,
	recipient address,
	amount int64,
	startHeight int64,
	cliffHeight int64,
	endHeight int64,
	cancellable bool,
	label string,
) uint64 {
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	coins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, amount))
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, coins)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sender))
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
	return CreateStream(cross(cur), recipient, startHeight, cliffHeight, endHeight, cancellable, label)
}

func TestCreateStreamAndEscrowBalance(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_create")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_create")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	balBefore := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 5_000_000, now, now+10, now+100, true, "Core Grant")
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)

	balAfter := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)
	uassert.Equal(t, balBefore+5_000_000, balAfter)

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, s.Sender)
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, s.Recipient)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), s.TotalAmount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusActive, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Core Grant", s.Label)
	uassert.True(t, s.Cancellable)

	// Invalid creations must abort
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, 1_000_000)))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: sender and recipient must differ", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), alice, now, now, now+10, true, "self")
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: invalid recipient address", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), "", now, now, now+10, true, "empty")
	})
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: must send positive ugnot only", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), bob, now, now, now+10, true, "no coins")
	})
}

func TestCliffEnforcementAndLifecycleWithdrawals(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_cliff")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_cliff")
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	bobStartBal := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	cliff := start + 25
	end := start + 100
	const total = int64(10_000_000)

	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, total, start, cliff, end, true, "Cliff Vesting")

	// Before cliff (height = start + 24): 0 withdrawable -> must abort
	testing.SkipHeights(24)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// At exact cliff (height = start + 25): 25% = 2_500_000 ugnot unlocks
	testing.SkipHeights(1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed1 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), claimed1)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+2_500_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusActive, mustGetStream(id).Status)

	// Immediate second withdraw at same height has 0 withdrawable
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Advance +35 blocks -> height = start + 60 (60% total vested = 6_000_000 -> 3_500_000 newly claimable)
	testing.SkipHeights(35)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed2 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_500_000), claimed2)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+6_000_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))

	// Advance past end (+50 blocks -> height = start + 110): remaining 4_000_000 unlocks & completes
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed3 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), claimed3)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+total, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCompleted, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, total, s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), completedCount)

	// Cannot withdraw from completed stream
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is not active", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestUnauthorizedWithdrawAndCancel(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_auth")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_auth")
	mallory := testutils.TestAddress("mallory_auth")

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 4_000_000, start, start, start+100, true, "Auth Test")

	testing.SkipHeights(50)

	// Sender (alice) cannot withdraw
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Random third party (mallory) cannot withdraw or cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(mallory))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can cancel", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Recipient (bob) cannot cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can cancel", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestNonCancellableStreamRejection(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_noncan")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_noncan")

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 2_000_000, start, start, start+100, false, "Irrevocable Grant")

	testing.SkipHeights(20)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is non-cancellable", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestCancelStreamZeroDustConservation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_cancel")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_cancel")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()

	aliceStart := roBanker.GetCoin(alice, DenomUGNOT)
	bobStart := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)
	pkgStart := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)

	// Prime non-divisible total across 97 blocks
	const total = int64(1_000_003)
	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, total, start, start+10, start+97, true, "Zero Dust Stream")

	// Recipient withdraws partially at height +30
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	firstClaim := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.True(t, firstClaim > 0)

	// Sender cancels at height +63 (33 blocks later)
	testing.SkipHeights(33)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	toRec, toSnd := CancelStream(cross(cur), id)

	// Strict zero-dust conservation: firstClaim + toRec + toSnd == total
	uassert.Equal(t, total, firstClaim+toRec+toSnd)

	// Verify exact bank balances moved
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStart+firstClaim+toRec, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, aliceStart+toSnd, roBanker.GetCoin(alice, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, pkgStart, roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT))

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCancelled, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, firstClaim+toRec, s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, toSnd, s.Refunded)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), cancelledCount)

	// Second cancel or withdraw must abort
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is not active", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestTopUpStream(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_topup")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_topup")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	bobStart := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 2_000_000, start, start, start+100, true, "Retainer")

	// Advance 50 blocks, unauthorized user cannot top up
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	topUpCoins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, 3_000_000))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can top up", func() {
		TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Sender tops up +3_000_000 -> total becomes 5_000_000
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, topUpCoins)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), mustGetStream(id).TotalAmount)

	// At 50% progress, recipient can withdraw 2_500_000
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), claimed)

	// At/after end height, TopUpStream must abort
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: cannot top up stream at or after end height", func() {
		TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Final withdraw claims remaining 2_500_000
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	finalClaim := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), finalClaim)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStart+5_000_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCompleted, mustGetStream(id).Status)
}

func TestRenderAndJSONEndpoints(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_render")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_render")

	// Empty state render
	emptyHome := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(emptyHome, "# StreamLedger"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(emptyHome, "No streams created yet"))

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 12_500_000, start, start+10, start+100, true, "Audit Bounty")
	testing.SkipHeights(50)

	// Dashboard render
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "12.500000 GNOT"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Audit Bounty"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "50.0%"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, ":stream/1"))

	// Stream detail render
	detail := Render("stream/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "# Stream #1 — Audit Bounty"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "6.250000 GNOT")) // 50% of 12.5 GNOT
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "$help&func=Withdraw"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "$help&func=CancelStream"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Zero-Dust Conservation Check"))

	// Address portfolio render (both recipient and sender)
	bobPage := Render("addr/" + bob.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bobPage, "Incoming Streams (1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bobPage, "6.250000 GNOT"))

	alicePage := Render("addr/" + alice.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(alicePage, "Outgoing Streams (1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(alicePage, "Audit Bounty"))

	// Unknown route & missing stream
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("stream/999"), "Not Found"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("unknown/path"), "Not Found"))

	// JSON endpoints
	streamJSON := GetStreamJSON(id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"id":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"totalAmountUgnot":12500000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"vestedUgnot":6250000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"withdrawableUgnot":6250000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"progressBps":5000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"status":"ACTIVE"`))

	uassert.Equal(t, `{"error":"stream not found"}`, GetStreamJSON(999))

	statsJSON := StatsJSON()
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"totalStreams":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"activeStreams":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"tvlUgnot":12500000`))
}

# grc1155 — a GRC1155-compatible multi-token package for Gno.land

`gno.land/p/g1j9c3manpp89kdyhjjqqyugty70kjy5w4sw9y0m/grc1155/v0` is a
multi-token (ERC1155-style) token package for Gno.land realms. One `Token`
issues many `TokenID`s, each with its own balance, total supply, and optional
URI override, and movements go through capability `Teller`s rather than raw
caller identity — the same security model as `gno.land/p/nt/grc721/v0`,
extended to batches.

## Why not the quarantined `p/nt/grc1155`

`examples/quarantined/gno.land/p/nt/grc1155/v0` (issue gnolang/gno#6202) had
five gaps. This package fixes each:

| # | Quarantined gap | Fix here |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Events were constructed then dropped | Every state change emits via `chain.Emit`: `NewToken`, `TransferSingle`, `TransferBatch`, `ApprovalForAll`, `URI` |
| 2 | "Safe" receiver checks were `return true` stubs | `safeTransferFrom`/`safeBatchTransferFrom` are deliberately omitted — a receiver-acceptance check needs a registry, and aliasing it would imply false safety |
| 3 | Authorised with `unsafe.OriginCaller()`, so any realm a user called could move their tokens | Writes resolve the actor per frame (`cur.Previous()` via `CallerTeller`) and `guardHome` confines frame-relative tellers to the token's own realm; a leaked `CallerTeller` returns `ErrForeignCallerTeller` abroad |
| 4 | Impl type unexported, could not be extended | `Token` is exported with unexported fields; realms compose through `Teller`, `PrivateLedger`, and the `Extension` hook interface |
| 5 | One global URI, no per-token supply or enumeration | Per-token `TotalSupply(tid)`, `Exists(tid)`, `URI(tid)` (per-id override over a `{id}` template), `HoldingsOf`, `TokenIDs` |

## Usage in a realm

```go
package forge

import (
	"gno.land/p/g1j9c3manpp89kdyhjjqqyugty70kjy5w4sw9y0m/grc1155/v0"
)

var (
	token     *grc1155.Token
	ledger    *grc1155.PrivateLedger
	userTeller grc1155.Teller
)

func init(cur realm) {
	token, ledger = grc1155.NewToken("Tavern Forge", "FORGE",
		"/r/g1j9c3manpp89kdyhjjqqyugty70kjy5w4sw9y0m/forge/v0:item/{id}", 0, cur)
	userTeller = ledger.CallerTeller()
}

// Crossing wrappers hand the frame's cur to the teller; the teller resolves
// the acting account as cur.Previous() and is home-guarded.
func Transfer(cur realm, to address, tid grc1155.TokenID, amount int64) error {
	return userTeller.TransferFrom(0, cur, cur.Previous().Address(), to, tid, amount)
}
```

Issuer-side operations (`Mint`, `MintBatch`, `Burn`, `BurnBatch`,
`SetURI`, `SetDefaultURI`, `RegisterExtension`) live on `*PrivateLedger`,
which only the creating realm ever holds. Holder-side operations go through
a `Teller`: `CallerTeller` (per-caller, home-guarded), `ReadonlyTeller`
(reads only), `RealmTeller`/`RealmSubTeller` (bound to the calling realm's
own address), and `ImpersonateTeller` (admin-grade, ledger-holder only).

Two identity details worth knowing before building on the package:

- `Token.ID()` is `pkgPath + "." + symbol` with no per-creation
  discriminator — a realm must not create two tokens with the same symbol,
  or their IDs collide in indexers and registries.
- `URI(tid)` substitutes `{id}` on-chain with the raw `TokenID` string,
  unlike EIP-1155 where clients fill in a 64-hex id themselves. Ids outside
  the write-path charset (`[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`) make `URI` return `""` rather
  than echoing unvalidated input.

## Events

Every state change emits via `chain.Emit`. `TransferSingle`/`TransferBatch`
carry EIP-1155 attributes — `token`, `operator`, `from`, `to`, `id`/`ids`,
`value`/`values` (batch ids and values comma-joined). `operator` is the
spender for `TransferFrom`/`BatchTransferFrom` and empty for mint/burn,
which have no spender. `Mint`/`MintBatch` emit with empty `from`,
`Burn`/`BurnBatch` with empty `to`. `ApprovalForAll` uses `owner`/`to`/
`approved`; `URI` carries `id` for per-token overrides and omits it for
the default template. A batch that returns an error emits nothing.

## Deliberate omissions

- **No `Safe*` functions.** EIP-1155's receiver-acceptance check
  (`onERC1155Received`) needs a registry of receiver contracts; providing a
  "safe" alias without one would imply safety that does not exist.
- **No per-token approvals.** EIP-1155 has none either — operator approval
  (`SetApprovalForAll`) covers all token ids.

## Import footprint

Deployed imports: `gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0` plus stdlibs (`chain`,
`math/overflow`, `strconv`, `strings`, `errors`). No `ufmt`, no `seqid`, no
other `/p/` or `/r/` packages — the transitive closure stays minimal so
chain-level package approval stays cheap.

// Stream represents a single escrowed ugnot payment/vesting stream.
type Stream struct {
	ID              uint64
	Sender          address
	Recipient       address
	TotalAmount     int64
	Withdrawn       int64
	Refunded        int64
	StartHeight     int64
	CliffHeight     int64
	EndHeight       int64
	CreatedHeight   int64
	CancelledHeight int64
	Cancellable     bool
	Status          string
	Label           string
}

var (
	streams     *avl.Tree // formatIDKey(id) -> *Stream
	bySender    *avl.Tree // "<sender>:<idKey>" -> uint64
	byRecipient *avl.Tree // "<recipient>:<idKey>" -> uint64

	nextStreamID   uint64
	totalDeposited int64
	totalWithdrawn int64
	totalRefunded  int64
	activeCount    int64
	completedCount int64
	cancelledCount int64

	router *mux.Router
)

func init() {
	initState()
	initRouter()
}

func initState() {
	streams = avl.NewTree()
	bySender = avl.NewTree()
	byRecipient = avl.NewTree()
	nextStreamID = 0
	totalDeposited = 0
	totalWithdrawn = 0
	totalRefunded = 0
	activeCount = 0
	completedCount = 0
	cancelledCount = 0
}

func initRouter() {
	router = mux.NewRouter()
	router.HandleFunc("", renderHome)
	router.HandleFunc("stream/{id}", renderStreamDetail)
	router.HandleFunc("addr/{address}", renderAddressPortfolio)
	router.SetNotFoundHandler(func(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# StreamLedger — Not Found\n\nUnknown path: `%s`\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", req.Path, realmURLPath))
	})
}

// CreateStream locks attached ugnot in escrow and creates a new linear vesting
// stream from the direct EOA caller to recipient.
func CreateStream(
	cur realm,
	recipient address,
	startHeight int64,
	cliffHeight int64,
	endHeight int64,
	cancellable bool,
	label string,
) uint64 {
	if !cur.Previous().IsUserCall() {
		panic("StreamLedger: only direct user call (maketx call) accepted")
	}

	sender := cur.Previous().Address()
	if recipient == "" || !recipient.IsValid() {
		panic("StreamLedger: invalid recipient address")
	}
	if recipient == sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: sender and recipient must differ")
	}

	deposit := requireUGNOTSent()
	if err := streammath.ValidateSchedule(startHeight, cliffHeight, endHeight, deposit); err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}

	cleanLabel := sanitizeLabel(label)
	newTotalDeposited, ok := overflow.Add64(totalDeposited, deposit)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: protocol deposit overflow")
	}

	nextStreamID++
	id := nextStreamID
	idKey := formatIDKey(id)

	s := &Stream{
		ID:            id,
		Sender:        sender,
		Recipient:     recipient,
		TotalAmount:   deposit,
		Withdrawn:     0,
		Refunded:      0,
		StartHeight:   startHeight,
		CliffHeight:   cliffHeight,
		EndHeight:     endHeight,
		CreatedHeight: runtime.ChainHeight(),
		Cancellable:   cancellable,
		Status:        StatusActive,
		Label:         cleanLabel,
	}

	streams.Set(idKey, s)
	bySender.Set(indexKey(sender, idKey), id)
	byRecipient.Set(indexKey(recipient, idKey), id)
	totalDeposited = newTotalDeposited
	activeCount++

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamCreated",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(id, 10),
		"sender", sender.String(),
		"recipient", recipient.String(),
		"amount_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(deposit, 10),
		"start_height", strconv.FormatInt(startHeight, 10),
		"cliff_height", strconv.FormatInt(cliffHeight, 10),
		"end_height", strconv.FormatInt(endHeight, 10),
		"cancellable", strconv.FormatBool(cancellable),
	)

	return id
}

// Withdraw claims all currently vested, unwithdrawn ugnot for streamID.
// Only the stream's recipient may call Withdraw. Strictly follows CEI.
func Withdraw(cur realm, streamID uint64) int64 {
	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if caller != s.Recipient {
		panic("StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw")
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	amount := streammath.WithdrawableAmount(
		s.TotalAmount,
		s.Withdrawn,
		s.StartHeight,
		s.CliffHeight,
		s.EndHeight,
		now,
	)
	if amount <= 0 {
		panic("StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height")
	}

	// Effects BEFORE external banker interaction (strict CEI).
	s.Withdrawn += amount
	totalWithdrawn += amount
	if s.Withdrawn >= s.TotalAmount {
		s.Status = StatusCompleted
		activeCount--
		completedCount++
	}

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamWithdrawn",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"recipient", s.Recipient.String(),
		"amount_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(amount, 10),
		"total_withdrawn_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(s.Withdrawn, 10),
		"status", s.Status,
	)

	// Interaction LAST.
	bk := banker.NewBanker(banker.BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)
	bk.SendCoins(cur.Address(), s.Recipient, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, amount)))

	return amount
}

// CancelStream cancels an active, cancellable stream. Only the sender may
// cancel. Any vested unwithdrawn balance is sent to the recipient and the
// exact unvested remainder is refunded to the sender (zero dust).
func CancelStream(cur realm, streamID uint64) (int64, int64) {
	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if !s.Cancellable {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is non-cancellable")
	}
	if caller != s.Sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: only sender can cancel")
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	toRecipient, toSender := streammath.CancelSplit(
		s.TotalAmount,
		s.Withdrawn,
		s.StartHeight,
		s.CliffHeight,
		s.EndHeight,
		now,
	)

	// Effects BEFORE external banker interactions (strict CEI).
	s.Withdrawn += toRecipient
	s.Refunded = toSender
	s.CancelledHeight = now
	s.Status = StatusCancelled

	totalWithdrawn += toRecipient
	totalRefunded += toSender
	activeCount--
	cancelledCount++

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamCancelled",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"sender", s.Sender.String(),
		"recipient", s.Recipient.String(),
		"to_recipient_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(toRecipient, 10),
		"to_sender_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(toSender, 10),
		"height", strconv.FormatInt(now, 10),
	)

	// Interactions LAST.
	bk := banker.NewBanker(banker.BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)
	realmAddr := cur.Address()
	if toRecipient > 0 {
		bk.SendCoins(realmAddr, s.Recipient, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, toRecipient)))
	}
	if toSender > 0 {
		bk.SendCoins(realmAddr, s.Sender, chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, toSender)))
	}

	return toRecipient, toSender
}

// TopUpStream adds attached ugnot to an active stream before its endHeight.
// Only the original sender may top up.
func TopUpStream(cur realm, streamID uint64) {
	if !cur.Previous().IsUserCall() {
		panic("StreamLedger: only direct user call (maketx call) accepted")
	}

	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	s := mustGetStream(streamID)

	if s.Status != StatusActive {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream is not active")
	}
	if caller != s.Sender {
		panic("StreamLedger: only sender can top up")
	}
	if runtime.ChainHeight() >= s.EndHeight {
		panic("StreamLedger: cannot top up stream at or after end height")
	}

	added := requireUGNOTSent()
	newStreamTotal, ok := overflow.Add64(s.TotalAmount, added)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream total overflow")
	}
	newProtocolTotal, ok := overflow.Add64(totalDeposited, added)
	if !ok {
		panic("StreamLedger: protocol deposit overflow")
	}

	s.TotalAmount = newStreamTotal
	totalDeposited = newProtocolTotal

	chain.Emit(
		"StreamToppedUp",
		"stream_id", strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10),
		"sender", s.Sender.String(),
		"added_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(added, 10),
		"new_total_ugnot", strconv.FormatInt(s.TotalAmount, 10),
	)
}

func renderHome(res *mux.ResponseWriter, _ *mux.Request) {
	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	tvl := totalDeposited - totalWithdrawn - totalRefunded
	createURL := txlink.NewLink("CreateStream").
		AddArgs(
			"recipient", "g1...",
			"startHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now, 10),
			"cliffHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now+10, 10),
			"endHeight", strconv.FormatInt(now+100, 10),
			"cancellable", "true",
			"label", "Contributor Vesting",
		).
		SetSend("1000000ugnot").
		URL()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# StreamLedger\n\n")
	b.WriteString("**Trustless, zero-dust native GNOT vesting & payment streams on Gno.land.**\n\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("Live Chain Height: **`#%d`** · [➕ Create New Stream](%s)\n\n", now, createURL))

	b.WriteString("## Protocol Overview\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Metric | Value |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Locked TVL** | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(tvl), tvl))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Deposited | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalDeposited)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Withdrawn | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalWithdrawn)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Refunded | %s |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalRefunded)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Streams | %d total (%d active · %d completed · %d cancelled) |\n\n",
		nextStreamID, activeCount, completedCount, cancelledCount))

	b.WriteString("## Streams\n\n")
	if streams.Size() == 0 {
		b.WriteString("_No streams created yet. Click **Create New Stream** above to lock your first GNOT vesting stream._\n")
		res.Write(b.String())
		return
	}

	b.WriteString("| ID | Label | Sender | Recipient | Total | Progress | Status |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n")

	streams.ReverseIterate("", "", func(_ string, value any) bool {
		s := value.(*Stream)
		_, _, _, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		bar := streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 10)
		lbl := s.Label
		if lbl == "" {
			lbl = "—"
		}
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf(
			"| [#%d](%s:stream/%d) | %s | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | %s | `%s` | %s |\n",
			s.ID, realmURLPath, s.ID,
			escapeMarkdownCell(lbl),
			shortAddr(s.Sender), realmURLPath, s.Sender.String(),
			shortAddr(s.Recipient), realmURLPath, s.Recipient.String(),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount),
			bar,
			statusBadge(s.Status),
		))
		return false
	})

	b.WriteString("\n---\n")
	b.WriteString("_Powered by pure 128-bit zero-dust math package `p/.../streammath`._\n")
	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderStreamDetail(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	rawID := req.GetVar("id")
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(rawID, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# Invalid Stream ID\n\n`%s` is not a valid stream ID.\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", rawID, realmURLPath))
		return
	}

	s := getStream(id)
	if s == nil {
		res.Write(ufmt.Sprintf("# Stream #%d Not Found\n\n[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n", id, realmURLPath))
		return
	}

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
	bar := streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 20)

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n\n", realmURLPath))
	title := ufmt.Sprintf("# Stream #%d", s.ID)
	if s.Label != "" {
		title += " — " + escapeMarkdownCell(s.Label)
	}
	b.WriteString(title + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("**Status:** %s · **Cancellable:** `%t` · **Live Height:** `#%d`\n\n", statusBadge(s.Status), s.Cancellable, now))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("`%s`\n\n", bar))

	b.WriteString("## Escrow & Schedule Details\n\n")
	b.WriteString("| Field | Value |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Sender | [%s](%s:addr/%s) |\n", s.Sender.String(), realmURLPath, s.Sender.String()))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Recipient | [%s](%s:addr/%s) |\n", s.Recipient.String(), realmURLPath, s.Recipient.String()))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Total Escrowed | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount), s.TotalAmount))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Vested | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(vested), vested))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Already Withdrawn | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.Withdrawn), s.Withdrawn))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Withdrawable Now** | **%s** (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(withdrawable), withdrawable))
	if s.Status == StatusCancelled {
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Refunded to Sender | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.Refunded), s.Refunded))
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Cancelled At Height | `#%d` |\n", s.CancelledHeight))
	} else {
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Remaining Unwithdrawn | %s (`%d ugnot`) |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(remaining), remaining))
	}
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Schedule (Start / Cliff / End) | `#%d` / `#%d` / `#%d` |\n", s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Created At Height | `#%d` |\n\n", s.CreatedHeight))

	// Zero-dust conservation proof display
	accounted := s.Withdrawn + s.Refunded + remaining
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("> **Zero-Dust Conservation Check:** `withdrawn (%d) + refunded (%d) + remaining (%d) == total (%d)`\n\n",
		s.Withdrawn, s.Refunded, remaining, accounted))

	if s.Status == StatusActive {
		idStr := strconv.FormatUint(s.ID, 10)
		withdrawURL := txlink.NewLink("Withdraw").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).URL()
		topUpURL := txlink.NewLink("TopUpStream").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).SetSend("1000000ugnot").URL()

		b.WriteString("## Actions\n\n")
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [💸 Withdraw Vested GNOT](%s) _(recipient only)_\n", withdrawURL))
		if now < s.EndHeight {
			b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [➕ Top Up Stream](%s) _(sender only, before `#%d`)_\n", topUpURL, s.EndHeight))
		}
		if s.Cancellable {
			cancelURL := txlink.NewLink("CancelStream").AddArgs("streamID", idStr).URL()
			b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("- [🛑 Cancel Stream (Zero-Dust Split)](%s) _(sender only)_\n", cancelURL))
		}
		b.WriteString("\n### CLI Example\n\n")
		b.WriteString("```bash\n")
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("gnokey maketx call -pkgpath %s -func Withdraw -args %d <your-key>\n", realmPkgPath, s.ID))
		b.WriteString("```\n")
	}

	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderAddressPortfolio(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	rawAddr := req.GetVar("address")
	addr := address(rawAddr)
	now := runtime.ChainHeight()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("[← Back to Dashboard](%s)\n\n", realmURLPath))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("# Portfolio: `%s`\n\n", rawAddr))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("Live Chain Height: **`#%d`**\n\n", now))

	incoming := collectStreamsByIndex(byRecipient, addr)
	outgoing := collectStreamsByIndex(bySender, addr)

	var totalIncoming, totalClaimable, totalOutgoing int64
	for _, s := range incoming {
		totalIncoming += s.TotalAmount
		_, w, _, _ := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		totalClaimable += w
	}
	for _, s := range outgoing {
		totalOutgoing += s.TotalAmount
	}

	b.WriteString("| Portfolio Summary | Amount |\n")
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Incoming Streams (%d) | %s |\n", len(incoming), streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalIncoming)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| **Claimable Now** | **%s** |\n", streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalClaimable)))
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| Outgoing Streams (%d) | %s |\n\n", len(outgoing), streammath.FormatUGNOT(totalOutgoing)))

	b.WriteString("## Incoming Streams (Recipient)\n\n")
	renderStreamList(&b, incoming, now, false)

	b.WriteString("\n## Outgoing Streams (Sender)\n\n")
	renderStreamList(&b, outgoing, now, true)

	res.Write(b.String())
}

func renderStreamList(b *strings.Builder, list []*Stream, now int64, isOutgoing bool) {
	if len(list) == 0 {
		b.WriteString("_None._\n")
		return
	}
	counterpartyCol := "Sender"
	if isOutgoing {
		counterpartyCol = "Recipient"
	}
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| ID | Label | %s | Total | Withdrawable | Progress | Status |\n", counterpartyCol))
	b.WriteString("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n")
	for _, s := range list {
		_, withdrawable, _, bps := computeLiveMetrics(s, now)
		cp := s.Sender
		if isOutgoing {
			cp = s.Recipient
		}
		lbl := s.Label
		if lbl == "" {
			lbl = "—"
		}
		b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf(
			"| [#%d](%s:stream/%d) | %s | [%s](%s:addr/%s) | %s | %s | `%s` | %s |\n",
			s.ID, realmURLPath, s.ID,
			escapeMarkdownCell(lbl),
			shortAddr(cp), realmURLPath, cp.String(),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(s.TotalAmount),
			streammath.FormatUGNOT(withdrawable),
			streammath.ProgressBar(bps, 10),
			statusBadge(s.Status),
		))
	}
}

// --- Internal helpers ---

func requireUGNOTSent() int64 {
	sent := unsafe.OriginSend()
	if len(sent) != 1 || sent[0].Denom != DenomUGNOT || sent[0].Amount <= 0 {
		panic("StreamLedger: must send positive ugnot only")
	}
	return sent[0].Amount
}

func sanitizeLabel(label string) string {
	clean := strings.TrimSpace(label)
	if len(clean) > MaxLabelLength {
		panic("StreamLedger: label exceeds maximum length of 120 bytes")
	}
	return clean
}

func formatIDKey(id uint64) string {
	s := strconv.FormatUint(id, 10)
	if len(s) < 20 {
		return strings.Repeat("0", 20-len(s)) + s
	}
	return s
}

func indexKey(addr address, idKey string) string {
	return addr.String() + ":" + idKey
}

func getStream(id uint64) *Stream {
	if id == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	v := streams.Get(formatIDKey(id))
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return v.(*Stream)
}

func mustGetStream(id uint64) *Stream {
	s := getStream(id)
	if s == nil {
		panic("StreamLedger: stream not found")
	}
	return s
}

func collectStreamsByIndex(idx *avl.Tree, addr address) []*Stream {
	prefix := addr.String() + ":"
	end := addr.String() + ";"
	var result []*Stream
	idx.ReverseIterate(prefix, end, func(key string, value any) bool {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(key, prefix) {
			return false
		}
		if id, ok := value.(uint64); ok {
			if s := getStream(id); s != nil {
				result = append(result, s)
			}
		}
		return false
	})
	return result
}

func computeLiveMetrics(s *Stream, now int64) (vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps int64) {
	switch s.Status {
	case StatusCompleted:
		return s.TotalAmount, 0, 0, streammath.MaxBps
	case StatusCancelled:
		return s.Withdrawn, 0, 0, streammath.ProgressBps(s.StartHeight, s.EndHeight, s.CancelledHeight)
	default:
		vested = streammath.VestedAmount(s.TotalAmount, s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		withdrawable = streammath.WithdrawableAmount(s.TotalAmount, s.Withdrawn, s.StartHeight, s.CliffHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		remaining = s.TotalAmount - s.Withdrawn
		bps = streammath.ProgressBps(s.StartHeight, s.EndHeight, now)
		return vested, withdrawable, remaining, bps
	}
}

func shortAddr(a address) string {
	s := a.String()
	if len(s) <= 14 {
		return s
	}
	return s[:8] + "…" + s[len(s)-4:]
}

func statusBadge(status string) string {
	switch status {
	case StatusActive:
		return "🟢 ACTIVE"
	case StatusCompleted:
		return "✅ COMPLETED"
	case StatusCancelled:
		return "🛑 CANCELLED"
	default:
		return status
	}
}

func escapeMarkdownCell(s string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "|", "\\|")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", " ")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r", "")
	return s
}

func escapeJSON(s string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, `\`, `\\`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, `"`, `\"`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", `\n`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r", `\r`)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\t", `\t`)
	return s
}

package streamledger

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"chain/runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func resetRealmForTest() {
	initState()
}

// fundAndCreate simulates a direct EOA MsgCall with attached ugnot.
func fundAndCreate(
	cur realm,
	sender address,
	recipient address,
	amount int64,
	startHeight int64,
	cliffHeight int64,
	endHeight int64,
	cancellable bool,
	label string,
) uint64 {
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	coins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, amount))
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, coins)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sender))
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
	return CreateStream(cross(cur), recipient, startHeight, cliffHeight, endHeight, cancellable, label)
}

func TestCreateStreamAndEscrowBalance(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_create")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_create")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	balBefore := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)

	now := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 5_000_000, now, now+10, now+100, true, "Core Grant")
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)

	balAfter := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)
	uassert.Equal(t, balBefore+5_000_000, balAfter)

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, s.Sender)
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, s.Recipient)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), s.TotalAmount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusActive, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Core Grant", s.Label)
	uassert.True(t, s.Cancellable)

	// Invalid creations must abort
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, 1_000_000)))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: sender and recipient must differ", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), alice, now, now, now+10, true, "self")
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: invalid recipient address", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), "", now, now, now+10, true, "empty")
	})
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: must send positive ugnot only", func() {
		CreateStream(cross(cur), bob, now, now, now+10, true, "no coins")
	})
}

func TestCliffEnforcementAndLifecycleWithdrawals(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_cliff")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_cliff")
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	bobStartBal := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	cliff := start + 25
	end := start + 100
	const total = int64(10_000_000)

	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, total, start, cliff, end, true, "Cliff Vesting")

	// Before cliff (height = start + 24): 0 withdrawable -> must abort
	testing.SkipHeights(24)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// At exact cliff (height = start + 25): 25% = 2_500_000 ugnot unlocks
	testing.SkipHeights(1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed1 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), claimed1)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+2_500_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusActive, mustGetStream(id).Status)

	// Immediate second withdraw at same height has 0 withdrawable
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: nothing withdrawable at current height", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Advance +35 blocks -> height = start + 60 (60% total vested = 6_000_000 -> 3_500_000 newly claimable)
	testing.SkipHeights(35)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed2 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_500_000), claimed2)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+6_000_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))

	// Advance past end (+50 blocks -> height = start + 110): remaining 4_000_000 unlocks & completes
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed3 := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), claimed3)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStartBal+total, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCompleted, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, total, s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), completedCount)

	// Cannot withdraw from completed stream
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is not active", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestUnauthorizedWithdrawAndCancel(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_auth")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_auth")
	mallory := testutils.TestAddress("mallory_auth")

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 4_000_000, start, start, start+100, true, "Auth Test")

	testing.SkipHeights(50)

	// Sender (alice) cannot withdraw
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Random third party (mallory) cannot withdraw or cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(mallory))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only recipient can withdraw", func() {
		Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can cancel", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Recipient (bob) cannot cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can cancel", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestNonCancellableStreamRejection(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_noncan")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_noncan")

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 2_000_000, start, start, start+100, false, "Irrevocable Grant")

	testing.SkipHeights(20)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is non-cancellable", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestCancelStreamZeroDustConservation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_cancel")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_cancel")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()

	aliceStart := roBanker.GetCoin(alice, DenomUGNOT)
	bobStart := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)
	pkgStart := roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT)

	// Prime non-divisible total across 97 blocks
	const total = int64(1_000_003)
	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, total, start, start+10, start+97, true, "Zero Dust Stream")

	// Recipient withdraws partially at height +30
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	firstClaim := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.True(t, firstClaim > 0)

	// Sender cancels at height +63 (33 blocks later)
	testing.SkipHeights(33)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	toRec, toSnd := CancelStream(cross(cur), id)

	// Strict zero-dust conservation: firstClaim + toRec + toSnd == total
	uassert.Equal(t, total, firstClaim+toRec+toSnd)

	// Verify exact bank balances moved
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStart+firstClaim+toRec, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, aliceStart+toSnd, roBanker.GetCoin(alice, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, pkgStart, roBanker.GetCoin(pkgAddr, DenomUGNOT))

	s := mustGetStream(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCancelled, s.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, firstClaim+toRec, s.Withdrawn)
	uassert.Equal(t, toSnd, s.Refunded)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), cancelledCount)

	// Second cancel or withdraw must abort
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: stream is not active", func() {
		CancelStream(cross(cur), id)
	})
}

func TestTopUpStream(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_topup")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_topup")
	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPkgPath)
	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	bobStart := roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT)

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 2_000_000, start, start, start+100, true, "Retainer")

	// Advance 50 blocks, unauthorized user cannot top up
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	topUpCoins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin(DenomUGNOT, 3_000_000))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: only sender can top up", func() {
		TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Sender tops up +3_000_000 -> total becomes 5_000_000
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, topUpCoins)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), mustGetStream(id).TotalAmount)

	// At 50% progress, recipient can withdraw 2_500_000
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	claimed := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), claimed)

	// At/after end height, TopUpStream must abort
	testing.SkipHeights(50)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(topUpCoins)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "StreamLedger: cannot top up stream at or after end height", func() {
		TopUpStream(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Final withdraw claims remaining 2_500_000
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	finalClaim := Withdraw(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_500_000), finalClaim)
	uassert.Equal(t, bobStart+5_000_000, roBanker.GetCoin(bob, DenomUGNOT))
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCompleted, mustGetStream(id).Status)
}

func TestRenderAndJSONEndpoints(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetRealmForTest()

	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice_render")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob_render")

	// Empty state render
	emptyHome := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(emptyHome, "# StreamLedger"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(emptyHome, "No streams created yet"))

	start := runtime.ChainHeight()
	id := fundAndCreate(cur, alice, bob, 12_500_000, start, start+10, start+100, true, "Audit Bounty")
	testing.SkipHeights(50)

	// Dashboard render
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "12.500000 GNOT"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Audit Bounty"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "50.0%"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, ":stream/1"))

	// Stream detail render
	detail := Render("stream/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "# Stream #1 — Audit Bounty"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "6.250000 GNOT")) // 50% of 12.5 GNOT
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "$help&func=Withdraw"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "$help&func=CancelStream"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Zero-Dust Conservation Check"))

	// Address portfolio render (both recipient and sender)
	bobPage := Render("addr/" + bob.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bobPage, "Incoming Streams (1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bobPage, "6.250000 GNOT"))

	alicePage := Render("addr/" + alice.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(alicePage, "Outgoing Streams (1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(alicePage, "Audit Bounty"))

	// Unknown route & missing stream
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("stream/999"), "Not Found"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("unknown/path"), "Not Found"))

	// JSON endpoints
	streamJSON := GetStreamJSON(id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"id":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"totalAmountUgnot":12500000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"vestedUgnot":6250000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"withdrawableUgnot":6250000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"progressBps":5000`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(streamJSON, `"status":"ACTIVE"`))

	uassert.Equal(t, `{"error":"stream not found"}`, GetStreamJSON(999))

	statsJSON := StatsJSON()
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"totalStreams":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"activeStreams":1`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"tvlUgnot":12500000`))
}

package fees

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

// ed25519 keys from seeds "aaaa..." and "bbbb..." (32 bytes); the signatures
// are over TicketMessage for alice at the test chain's genesis time + 3600.
const (
	keyA            = "af06a3e3291714e4f356c19c9b15cd1951ec6e6662aa77be07547f289383341d"
	keyB            = "2df04125f0015afb47ce853aef8772094ff9498c14cb1b9e12973c2927da0fa6"
	sigATier2       = "96ec6f0b7ee676f5577e107a7edb1b2aba49aec6aae262be787d0199b880b14b63ceb8fdc553b2d60084a527afb160e9851ed00b9aaaa5747fa47f76ca54a602"
	sigATier1       = "79294a555bfcbb14222586c1ea488b6c6eaa5822844d1c269d7c4a54ce2110630e47b87e2b9db9fce8b3ff122d495915f74b437dbdcf6a62131e69bbb0b3c40a"
	sigBTier2       = "0e4b90aead6c2b3a6dfbdb604bb68482f45ccb6011ef7ecbb543eb8205bb4251588b649d1586349fac1344df38232e13bd8077ce97961bbd6aebbba23ba03b01"
	timelockHeights = 2*24*60*60/5 + 1 // a block is 5s in tests
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
)

func TestTickets(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	exp := time.Now().Unix() + 3600
	admin := Owner()

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotOwner", func() { SetInitialSigner(cross(cur), keyA) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	SetInitialSigner(cross(cur), keyA)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "SignerAlreadySet", func() { SetInitialSigner(cross(cur), keyB) })

	uassert.Equal(t, BaseBps, EntryBps(alice))

	// A ticket is bound to its account: bob cannot apply alice's.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadSignature", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 2, exp, sigATier2) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadSignature", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 1, exp, sigATier2) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadTier", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 3, exp, sigATier2) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadExpiry", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 2, time.Now().Unix(), sigATier2) })
	ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 2, exp, sigATier2)
	uassert.Equal(t, WhaleBps, EntryBps(alice))
	ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 1, exp, sigATier1)
	uassert.Equal(t, HolderBps, EntryBps(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, BaseBps, EntryBps(bob))

	// Revoking retires every applied ticket and verifies nothing.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	RevokeSigner(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, BaseBps, EntryBps(alice))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadSignature", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 1, exp, sigATier1) })
}

func TestSignerTimelockAndExpiry(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	admin := Owner()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	QueueSigner(cross(cur), keyB)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "Timelocked", func() { ExecuteSigner(cross(cur)) })
	testing.SkipHeights(timelockHeights)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob)) // permissionless once due
	epoch := SignerEpoch()
	ExecuteSigner(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, epoch+1, SignerEpoch())
	uassert.Equal(t, keyB, Signer())
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NothingQueued", func() { ExecuteSigner(cross(cur)) })
	// The fixed signatures were made for genesis + 3600; that time has passed.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "BadExpiry", func() { ApplyTicket(cross(cur), 2, 1234571490, sigBTier2) })
}

func TestOwnershipTimelock(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	admin := Owner()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	TransferOwnership(cross(cur), bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "Timelocked", func() { AcceptOwnership(cross(cur)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "NotPendingOwner", func() { AcceptOwnership(cross(cur)) })
	testing.SkipHeights(timelockHeights)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	AcceptOwnership(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, Owner())
	uassert.Equal(t, address(""), PendingOwner())
}
